title: Delete vowels from a sentence
summary: Remove English vowel letters from a string.
requirements: Treat both uppercase and lowercase A, E, I, O, U as vowels.
Preserve all other characters, spaces, and punctuation.
hints: A case-insensitive character class can recognize vowels.
Replace every match with an empty string.

examples.label: Typical case
input: This website is for losers LOL!
examples.output: Ths wbst s fr lsrs LL!

tests.name: Common case — ["This website is for losers LOL!"]
input: This website is for losers LOL!
tests.expected: Ths wbst s fr lsrs LL!
